segments.he: נִגְמַר דִּינוֹ וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב: שְׁתֵּי טָעִיּוֹת טָעָה יוֹאָב בְּאוֹתָהּ שָׁעָה, דִּכְתִיב: ״וַיָּנׇס יוֹאָב אֶל אֹהֶל ה׳ וַיַּחֲזֵק בְּקַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ״,
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If «the verdict of» a murderer was decided at a time when there was no High Priest, and likewise in the cases of one who unintentionally killed a High Priest and in the case of a High Priest who killed unintentionally, the unintentional murderer never leaves the city of refuge. And one who is exiled may not leave the city at all; even if the Jewish people require his services, and even if he is the general of the army of the Jewish people like Joab ben Zeruiah, he does not leave the city of refuge ever. «Rav Yehuda says» that «Rav says: Joab made two errors at that moment,» when he fled from Solomon, «as it is written: “And Joab fled to the Tent of God and grasped the horns of the altar”» (I Kings 2:28).
